name: What is the average cost of an interior home renovation in the East Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of an interior home renovation in the East Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of interior home renovations in the East Bay Area, including Berkeley, Oakland, and Albany, can vary widely. Minor updates might range from $10,000 to $30,000, while a complete kitchen or bathroom remodel can cost between $40,000 and $100,000 or more, depending on materials and finishes. Whole-house renovations can easily exceed $150,000. We recommend a detailed consultation to provide an accurate estimate based on your specific project requirements and selections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary greatly; minor updates start around $10,000, while major remodels can exceed $40,000.
